description: This file defines a runtime cache system for managing runtime state objects, including storage, retrieval, snapshotting, and idle detection functionality.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class implementing a cache for runtime state objects, supporting addition, access, removal, snapshotting, and idle candidate detection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific actor key exists in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state associated with the actor key; optionally updates the lastTouchedAt timestamp unless touch is false.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state without updating the lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the last time the cache entry for an actor key was touched.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a new runtime state for the given actor key and updates its last touched time.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Generates a snapshot of all cache entries, including their idle times.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Returns cache entries that have been idle for at least maxIdleMs milliseconds.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
